description: Bring back an expired drop owned by the authenticated account, however long ago it expired (requires an sp_ API key on a paid plan). The restored drop doesn't expire while the account stays on Pro. Free accounts get a 402 subscription_required with an upgrade_url.

slug.description: The drop slug (the subdomain part of its ${domain} URL).

name: restore_drop

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp after the restore, or null when the drop never expires

restored.description: False when the drop was not expired and nothing changed

title: Restore an expired drop
